Characters to be deleted are not required to go successively, there can be any gaps between them. For example, for the string "abaca" the following strings are subsequences: "abaca", "aba", "aaa", "a" and "" (empty string). The set $$$S$$$ can't contain duplicates. This move costs $$$n - |t|$$$, where $$$|t|$$$ is the length of the added subsequence (i.e. the price equals to the number of the deleted characters).Your task is to find out the minimum possible total cost to obtain a set $$$S$$$ of size $$$k$$$ or report that it is impossible to do so.
